verdict.rationale: Shopify gives agent developers a quickstart that runs the full flow with the UCP CLI in about five minutes, and the CLI can fetch each merchant's live input schema via `--input-schema`. A hands-on probe confirmed the documented CLI commands work against live endpoints. There is no evidence of an interactive, try-it-in-browser API reference or explorer, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path, so the 'interactive reference' half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer or try-it console, a machine-readable OpenAPI/reference spec, and runnable examples embedded directly in the reference pages.
